entries.02fbeb4102cc0390: In May 2024, it formulated a new medium-term management plan, "Change 2027." entries.24ef8833c63a7405: This is a category handled by the company (H-ONE) itself, which manufactures and sells automotive parts in Japan. entries.f781e585fdddaf7b: In May 1984, the company and Hongo Seisakusho Co., Ltd. invested in the establishment of KTH Parts Industries, Inc. (now a consolidated subsidiary), which makes and sells automobile parts in Ohio, United States of America. Subsequently, it jointly established Kalida Manufacturing, Inc. in Ohio in February 1996, KTH Shelburne Manufacturing, Inc. in Ontario, Canada in May 1997, and KTH Leesburg Products, LLC. in Alabama in June 2000 (all now consolidated subsidiaries).
entries.f8176a52afe161d5: Sales of merchandise and products (¥209,074 million for the fiscal year ended March 2026, including revenue of ¥5,946 million arising from leases under IFRS 16)
entries.f854795d1b93dd96: In January 2002, the company and Hongo Co., Ltd. established Guangzhou Aiji Auto Parts Co., Ltd. in Guangdong Province, People's Republic of China. In February 2005, it established Qingyuan Aiji Auto Parts Co., Ltd. in Guangdong Province and Wuhan Aiji Auto Parts Co., Ltd. in Hubei Province. Subsequently, in July 2020, it established Dongfeng Aiji Auto Press Parts Co., Ltd. in Hubei Province (a joint investment with Dongfeng Die Stamping Technology Co., Ltd. and Wuhan Aiji Auto Parts Co., Ltd.; now an equity-method affiliate), and in September 2022, it established Wuhan Aiji New Energy Automobile Co., Ltd. in the same province.
entries.f868e93019969ea9: In June 1967, it received an order for automobile frame parts from [[company:honda|HONDA MOTOR CO., LTD.]] and began full-scale mass production of automobile parts.
entries.faa10af41835d12f: This [[term:segment|segment]] manufactures and sells automotive parts through local subsidiaries in the United States, Canada and Mexico. The [[term:consolidated-subsidiary|consolidated subsidiaries]] are five companies: KTH Parts Industries, Inc. (Ohio), Kalida Manufacturing, Inc. (Ohio), KTH Leesburg Products, LLC. (Alabama) and KTH Texas, Inc. (Ohio) in the United States, and KTH Shelburne Manufacturing, Inc. (Ontario) in Canada. G-ONE AUTO PARTS DE MEXICO, S.A. DE C.V. (Guanajuato) in Mexico is an equity-method affiliate. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥112,577 million (¥115,425 million in the prior year), the largest of the four reportable segments and more than half of consolidated revenue of ¥209,659 million. Segment profit (operating profit) was ¥5,860 million (¥4,393 million in the prior year). The company explains that, because production of automobile frames for its main customers fell from the prior year due to the semiconductor supply shortage, revenue including intersegment transactions was ¥112,682 million, down 2.3% year on year; meanwhile, profit increased due to the effects of structural reforms, including streamlining and efficiency improvements of existing production lines and a major review of production patterns. KTH Texas, Inc. was established in August 2025 and joined the North American operations as a consolidated subsidiary from the third-quarter consolidated accounting period. There are 1,832 employees (439 temporary employees, not included in that figure), and capital expenditure for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥15,636 million.
